name: pancreas
draw: Elongated tapered organ lying horizontally, a wide rounded head at one end narrowing to a thin tail, with a duct line running through it.

name: spleen
draw: Curved bean-like organ shaped like a fat crescent, with a notch on the inner edge where small vessels enter.

name: gallbladder
draw: Pear-shaped sac hanging from a short curved duct, with two small round stones visible inside.

name: appendix
draw: Lower end of the large intestine drawn as a rounded pouch with a small finger-like tube hanging from it.

name: esophagus
draw: Long vertical tube running from a throat outline down into the top of a stomach shape.

name: trachea
draw: Vertical windpipe tube made of stacked horizontal cartilage rings, splitting into two short branches at the bottom.

name: larynx
draw: Front view of the voice box: a shield-shaped cartilage with a notch at the top, sitting on a ringed tube.

name: vocal-cords
draw: Top view down the throat of two pale folds forming a V shape inside a rounded opening.

name: diaphragm
draw: Dome-shaped muscle arching beneath the outline of two lungs, with a small up and down arrow below it.

name: bronchial-tree
draw: Windpipe splitting into two bronchi that keep branching into smaller tubes like an upside-down tree.

name: alveoli
draw: Cluster of small round air sacs like a bunch of grapes at the end of a single branching tube.

name: heart-cross-section
draw: Anatomical heart cut open to show four chambers separated by a central wall and valve lines.

name: capillaries
draw: Fine mesh of thin branching vessels linking a thicker vessel on each side.

name: lymph-node
draw: Bean-shaped node with several thin vessels entering its curved side and one leaving from the notch.

name: tonsils
draw: Wide open mouth seen from the front with the hanging uvula in the middle and an oval tonsil on either side of the throat.

name: thymus
draw: Two-lobed gland shaped like a pair of soft leaves sitting just above a small heart outline.

name: bone-marrow
draw: Long bone cut open lengthwise showing a hollow center filled with dotted spongy marrow.

name: adrenal-glands
draw: Pair of kidneys each topped by a small triangular cap gland, the caps drawn solid.

name: pituitary-gland
draw: Side view of a brain with a small pea-shaped gland hanging on a short stalk from its underside.

name: prostate
draw: Walnut-shaped gland wrapped around the base of a bladder outline, with a thin tube passing through it.

name: salivary-glands
draw: Head in side profile with small gland shapes near the ear and under the jaw, joined by thin ducts to the mouth.

name: sinuses
draw: Front view face outline with paired air cavities drawn above the eyebrows and beside the nose.

name: cochlea
draw: Snail-shell spiral of the inner ear with a short stub where the hearing nerve leaves.

name: ear-anatomy
draw: Cross-section of the ear: the outer ear shell, a canal to the eardrum, three tiny bones and a snail spiral at the inner end.

name: eye-anatomy
draw: Side cross-section of an eyeball showing the lens at the front and the optic nerve leaving from the back.

name: brain-lobes
draw: Side view brain divided by clear lines into four lobe sections, with the small cerebellum below.

name: cerebellum
draw: Side view brain drawn in outline with the small striped cerebellum at the lower back drawn solid.

name: brainstem
draw: Side view brain drawn in outline with the stalk-like brainstem descending from its base drawn solid.

name: brain-hemispheres
draw: Brain seen from above, split down the middle into two matching halves with folds on each.

name: synapse
draw: Two nerve endings meeting across a small gap, with tiny dots of chemical messengers crossing between them.

name: spinal-cord
draw: Long vertical cord with pairs of nerve roots branching out to both sides at even intervals, no vertebrae shown.

name: skin-layers
draw: Square block of skin in cross-section with three stacked layers and a single hair rising from a root below.

name: hair-follicle
draw: Single hair growing out of a bulb-shaped pocket beneath a wavy skin surface line.

name: tooth-anatomy
draw: Molar cut in half showing the enamel crown, the inner pulp chamber and two roots set below a gum line.

name: gums
draw: Row of front teeth set into a curved gum band, the gums drawn as a bold scalloped shape.

name: incisor
draw: Single flat chisel-shaped front tooth with a straight biting edge and one long root.

name: canine-tooth
draw: Single pointed cuspid tooth with a sharp tip and one long tapering root.

name: wisdom-tooth
draw: Molar lying tilted inside a jaw outline, pushing sideways against the neighboring tooth.

name: dental-arch
draw: Top view of a horseshoe-shaped row of teeth, as drawn on a dental chart.

name: internal-organs
draw: Torso outline showing the lungs, heart, liver, stomach and coiled intestines stacked inside.

name: digestive-system
draw: Torso and head outline with one path from the mouth down the esophagus to the stomach and the coiled intestines.

name: respiratory-system
draw: Head and torso outline with the nasal passage and windpipe leading down into two lungs.

name: circulatory-system
draw: Standing body outline with a heart in the chest and branching vessels running out to the arms and legs.

name: nervous-system
draw: Standing body outline with the brain and spinal cord drawn solid and thin nerves branching out to the limbs.

name: muscular-system
draw: Front view figure with visible muscle bands on the chest, arms, abdomen and thighs.

name: endocrine-system
draw: Body outline with small gland dots marked in the head, neck, chest, abdomen and pelvis.

name: lymphatic-system
draw: Body outline with thin vessels along the limbs and clusters of small node dots at the neck, armpits and groin.

name: male-reproductive-system
draw: Clinical front view diagram of a bladder outline with the prostate below it and paired testes joined by thin ducts.

name: femur
draw: Long thigh bone with a ball-shaped head set at an angle on a short neck at the top and a double knob at the bottom.

name: vertebra
draw: Single vertebra seen from above: a round body with a ring behind it and three pointed bony spurs.

name: hand-skeleton
draw: Bones of the hand: small wrist bones at the base with five chains of finger bones spreading upward.

name: foot-skeleton
draw: Bones of the foot seen from above: the heel bone, small ankle bones and five chains of toe bones.

name: collarbone
draw: Slender S-curved horizontal bone with rounded ends, lying across the top of a shoulder outline.

name: shoulder-blade
draw: Flat triangular bone with a ridge across its upper part and a shallow socket at the outer corner.

name: ball-and-socket-joint
draw: Rounded bone head sitting in a cup-shaped socket, both bone ends shown in cross-section.

name: red-blood-cell
draw: Round disc cell with a dimpled center, shown face on as a ring and beside it edge on as a pinched oval.

name: white-blood-cell
draw: Round cell with a bumpy edge and a large multi-lobed nucleus inside.

name: platelet
draw: Three small irregular cell fragments with short spiky arms, grouped together.

name: sickle-cell
draw: Crescent sickle-shaped red blood cell next to one normal round disc cell.

name: antibody
draw: Y-shaped antibody molecule with two arms and a stem, each part drawn as a double line.

name: chromosome
draw: X-shaped chromosome of two arms pinched together at the center, with band lines across each arm.

name: cell-division
draw: One cell pinched in the middle into two round halves, each holding its own nucleus.

name: mitochondrion
draw: Oval capsule-shaped organelle with a wavy folded inner membrane running along its length.

name: cancer-cell
draw: Irregular lumpy cell with an oversized nucleus and several small spiky protrusions on its edge.

name: stem-cell
draw: Central round cell with three short arrows leading to smaller specialized cells of different shapes.

name: sperm-cell
draw: Sperm cell with an oval head and a long wavy tail.

name: ovum
draw: Large round egg cell with a thick outer ring, a small nucleus and a few tiny cells hugging its edge.

name: fertilization
draw: Large round egg cell with a single sperm cell touching its surface, the tail trailing away.

name: embryo
draw: Early embryo as a tight round ball of eight clustered cells inside a thin outer ring.

name: fetus
draw: Curled fetus in side view inside a round womb outline, with a large head, tucked knees and an umbilical cord.

name: rna
draw: Single wavy strand with short base rungs sticking out on one side only.

name: bacteriophage
draw: Virus shaped like a lunar lander: an angular head on a straight tail with jointed legs splayed below.

name: spiral-bacteria
draw: Corkscrew-shaped spiral bacterium with a small whip tail at each end.

name: streptococcus
draw: Chain of small round bacteria beads linked in a gently curving line.

name: glutes
draw: Rear view of the hips and buttocks with the gluteal muscles drawn solid and the legs in outline below.

name: quadriceps
draw: Front view of a thigh with the large four-part muscle above the knee drawn solid.

name: hamstrings
draw: Rear view of a thigh with the long back-of-thigh muscles between hip and knee drawn solid.

name: triceps
draw: Rear view of an upper arm with the horseshoe-shaped muscle above the elbow drawn solid.

name: lats
draw: Rear view torso with the wide wing-shaped muscles on each side of the back drawn solid, forming a V.

name: traps
draw: Rear view of the neck and shoulders with the diamond-shaped trapezius muscle drawn solid from neck to mid back.
